best_idea: A destroyed or defeated thing runs a fixed-step stage timeline (burning, then smoking, then gone) that is pure state, with the visual frame derived from its progress, so the look of a death or ruin can be tested in ticks.
decision_why: Keep the three-stage ruin timeline for a defeated actor's remains, timed in sim ticks; drop building-to-building spread and the cover rule unless Lead wants zone hazards, because neither is a Frankendom ruling today.
acceptance: A server test advances a defeated actor's remains by N sim ticks and asserts burning, smoking, gone at the configured tick counts; the client shows smoke frame 0 to 4 in step with smoking progress, and the remains clear on the same tick on every client.
